obligations.behavior: TDD obligation synthesis builds a deterministic plan from accepted PRD requirements and accepted ADRs, preserving source PRD/ADR refs, coverage tier, suggested obligation type, owner path, command, and blocker reason when automation is unavailable.

The synthesis plan is plan-only: it does not overwrite tdd.json, mutate PRD/ADR/evidence/traceability artifacts, generate briefs, evaluate coverage gates, execute models, or dispatch implementation work.

idiom product tdd --plan-obligations reads the durable effort, emits JSON plan metadata and typed findings, fails closed for missing/invalid PRD, ADR index, ADR markdown, or TDD ledger inputs, and preserves the current durable fixture pass path.

obligations.behavior: Coverage gate evaluation deterministically checks existing PRD, accepted ADRs, TDD coverage metadata, and traceability inputs against tier-specific blocking criteria, returning typed pass/block findings without heuristic model judgment.

idiom product tdd --evaluate-coverage reads the durable effort and emits JSON coverage-gate metadata plus typed findings, fails closed for missing or invalid PRD, ADR, TDD, or traceability inputs, and preserves the durable fixture pass path.

Coverage gate tier selection blocks documentation/local_low/behavior_standard/contract_high/formal_optional criteria according to the design table, including explicit blockers for unavailable automation instead of silent pass.

obligations.behavior: Brief generation deterministically renders a bounded implementation brief from accepted PRD requirements, accepted ADR decisions, current TDD obligations, traceability evidence, and a passing coverage-gate evaluation, including required brief-lint sections and stable artifact references.

idiom product brief --render reads the durable effort, fails closed when required artifacts are missing or the coverage gate is blocked, supports JSON output and human-readable text output, and writes only the requested brief path without dispatching work or executing models.
Generated briefs use the existing idiom brief lint contract rather than duplicating dispatch lint logic; the CLI verifies or reports lint blockers before claiming a generated brief is dispatch-ready.

Feedback records preserve authority boundaries: lane and evidence artifacts are observed outcomes, PRD/ADR/TDD artifacts remain upstream evidence, and existing brief lint, atom intake, lane contracts, and verification gates remain the dispatch authority.

obligations.behavior: Obsidian parity checking deterministically compares the workflow proposal and roadmap notes against durable workflow state, detecting stale status labels, phase checkboxes, and roadmap bullets before atom closeout.

idiom product lint and idiom product audit expose typed Obsidian parity findings in JSON and human-readable output for stale proposal/roadmap status, while preserving the current durable fixture pass path.
